items.prompt: For positive fixed future cashflows, midpoint price is ABOVE target. Which yield endpoint changes?

options.text: Raise the lower yield endpoint to midpoint
options.why: Price decreases with yield under these assumptions.

options.text: Lower the upper endpoint below midpoint
options.why: That moves toward even higher prices.
The target may still be inside the preserved bracket.

options.text: Change the promised cashflows to match price
options.why: That changes the problem rather than solving it.

items.explanation: The derivative is strictly negative, so a higher yield is needed to reduce model price.
